title: browser.recording/v1
description: Schemas for the files of a browser recording directory (AIP-63 section 6). manifest.json validates against $defs/manifest. Each line of frames.jsonl validates against $defs/frame and each line of actions.jsonl against $defs/action. The property sets are closed on purpose: there is no field in which a typed value of a masked input could be placed (R8, R9).

recordingId.description: Also the name of the recording directory. No dot and no slash, so it cannot traverse (R1).

schema.description: `browser-recording/v1` is accepted as a legacy alias (AIP-70).

sessionId.description: The agent or browser session that was recorded.

provider.description: The id of the BROWSER.md provider that drove the browser (for example chrome-live, chromium, bureau).

adapter.description: The adapter package or host component that captured the frames, when different from the provider.

deviceId.description: AIP-59 device that owns the recording. When present, any other paired device MUST NOT read it (R11).

grantIds.description: Ids of the profile grants (AIP-63 section 4) that seeded the recorded session. Ids only, never material (R13).

mode.description: How frames were produced. The file format is identical in both modes (R6).

screencast.description: Capture parameters, for mode screencast. Informational.

status.description: recording: the writer is live. complete: closed normally. failed: the writer hit an error it could not recover from (see statusReason). interrupted: the host stopped or crashed while recording (R14).

passwordFields.description: masked is the default. none is an explicit operator opt-out and MUST be recorded here (R8).

droppedFrames.description: Frames that could not be masked with certainty and were not written (R9).

retentionDays.description: Days after endedAt (or after startedAt, if the recording never ended) at which the host MUST delete the whole directory (R10).

exports.description: Derived files under exports/. Not part of the format proper: a reader MUST be able to regenerate them from frames and actions (R15).

allOf.description: R3, R14: a live recording has no end; any other status has one.
R6: capture parameters only make sense for the screencast mode.

file.description: Path relative to the recording directory. The number is i, zero-padded to at least six digits (R5).

url.description: Page URL at capture time, with fragment and any userinfo removed (R7).

w.description: Pixel width of the stored JPEG. It MAY be smaller than the viewport (R5).

actionSeq.description: seq of the action this frame follows. Required in per-action mode, optional in screencast mode (R6).

masked.description: none: no sensitive field visible. fields: the regions of sensitive fields were masked. full: the whole frame was blurred because masking could not be scoped (R8, R9). Absent means none.

prev.description: SHA-256 of the previous line of this file (SHOULD, R3).

action.description: One line of actions.jsonl. There is no field that holds a typed or evaluated value in clear (R7).

tMs.description: Start of the action, in milliseconds since manifest.startedAt.

tool.description: The browser tool without the browser. prefix: navigate, click, fill, evaluate, screenshot, scroll, get_dom, extract_text, act, tabs, or a vendor tool.

url.description: Page URL when the action started, with fragment and any userinfo removed.

target.description: What the action was aimed at. A locator, never a value (R7).

name.description: Accessible name of the element, not its value.

sensitive.description: The element is a password-like field (R8). Present means the value was redacted from the summary.

summary.description: One human-readable line. For a fill on a sensitive field it MUST NOT contain the value, not even its length (R7).

code.description: A browser:* code from AIP-63 T4 or a vendor code.

redacted.description: Some part of this action was removed by the writer (R7).

prev.description: SHA-256 of the previous line of this file (SHOULD, R3).

allOf.description: R7: an error status carries an error, an ok status does not.
R7: a fill that targets a sensitive field is marked redacted.
